## Goal

Evaluate the effectiveness of Stage 2 (fast-mode idle lease 30s→15s) against the baseline, specifically watching the orphan-cleanup risk the earlier 15s test tripped (15x increase, LP-0MSKOHV55003XFTB).

## Method

1. Run the canonical analysis over a post-change 24h window (same weekday mix where possible):
   `python3 .pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/analyze_proxy_usage.py --log-dir /var/log/llama-proxy --hours 24`
2. Compare against the 2026-10-14 baseline (archived under `/home/rgardler/proxy-usage-reports/`): `local_lease_active` 79, dispatch denied 163, busy 36.5%, capture 14.5%, p90 TTFT fast 10.1s.
3. Metrics:
   - `local_lease_active` and `local_dispatch_denied` counts (should fall)
   - Local busy time %, capture rate (should rise)
   - **Orphan-cleanup signature** (the regression risk): grep the fast-mode proxy log (`/var/log/llama-proxy/proxy.log`) for `dispatch_first_byte_timeout`, orphan cleanup / `session cleanup` events, and client retries; compare their rate against the LP-0MSKOHV55003XFTB failure signature. A spike means the 15s lease is releasing mid-flight despite the T1–T3 mitigations.
   - Mid-request lease expiry events (`lease expired` / `orphan`) per session
   - TTFT p90/median, `slot_save failed`, backend_retry
4. Because Stage 3 (thresholds) may already be live by the time this runs, isolate Stage 2's effect by comparing sequential windows (Stage 2 window vs Stage 1 window) and attribute via the config diff, or use the report's per-session lease-event timing vs the 15s mark.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Local capture rate (local served / total demand) is higher than the 14.5% baseline.
- [ ] All guardrail metrics are flat or improved; no critical regression. Guardrails: p90 TTFT, remote-error rate, `slot_save failed`, `fallback_after_queue`, peak concurrency ≤ slot count.
- [ ] Verdict per metric (improved / flat / regressed) with before/after numbers.
- [ ] Explicit answer to: does 15s cause an orphan-cleanup spike in the fast profile, and is it justified by the `local_lease_active`/denial reduction?
- [ ] Keep/revert recommendation recorded on this item and fed back to the parent epic.
- [ ] Analysis-only: no config changes here.

## Notes

- The prior 15s→30s reversal (LP-0MSUO82NF002HUMC) is the comparator: the 30s safety net was adopted because the 15s verification showed the 15x cleanup increase. Re-verifying this specific risk is the entire point of the item.

## Key Files

- `proxy/config-fast.yaml` and `proxy/config.yaml` — the fast-mode lease config (Stage 2 change target; verify which value is live before measuring)
- `/var/log/llama-proxy/proxy.log` — fast-mode proxy log grepped for the orphan-cleanup signature
- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/analyze_proxy_usage.py` — canonical analysis CLI
- `/home/rgardler/proxy-usage-reports/` — baseline and post-change report archives
data.title: Evaluate stage 2: fast idle lease 15s effectiveness & orphan-cleanup risk

data.description:
# Respect MunitoAI `x-ratelimit-*` reset headers on quota 429s

## Goal

The proxy currently treats MunitoAI quota 429s as generic per-account rate
limits: it applies only the standard short provider cooldown (60s +
exponential backoff) and discards the rate-limit reset information MunitoAI
exposes via its `x-ratelimit-*` response headers. Add reset-aware handling so
an exhausted MunitoAI account is skipped with an accurate cooldown/reset time
instead of being re-tried blindly inside the reset window — while siblings on
the same gateway with independent quota (e.g. paid `munitoai` vs
`munitoai-free`) remain eligible, preserving the per-request account-key
exclusion semantics of LP-0MVCX0E2V001VB5N.

## Context / findings

Investigation of a live "what happens on a quota error" question (2026-10-18)
established:

- **Observed MunitoAI 429 body** (35 occurrences in proxy.log on 2026-10-18):
  `{"error":{"message":"Too Many Requests","type":"rate_limit_error","param":null,"code":"rate_limit_exceeded"}}`
  — no `Retry-After` header, no `"Resets in ..."` duration, no
  `metadata.limitName`.
- **MunitoAI signals rate-limit state via `x-ratelimit-*` headers** (live
  probe): `x-ratelimit-limit-requests`, `x-ratelimit-remaining-requests`,
  `x-ratelimit-reset-requests` (e.g. `"32s"`), `x-ratelimit-over-limit`.
  The proxy parses **none** of these headers (zero references in
  `proxy/proxy/*.py`).
- Because `_usage_limit_reset_info()` only recognises
  `GoUsageLimitError`/`FreeUsageLimitError` and `_parse_retry_after()` finds
  no header, `munitoai-free` gets only the standard 60s backoff cooldown and
  is re-tried every cycle — the observed logs show repeated
  `munitoai-free in cooldown (Ns remaining)` lines and fallback onto paid
  opencode/DeepSeek tiers.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1 — Reset-aware cooldown:** when a 429 `rate_limit_error` response
      from a MunitoAI provider includes an `x-ratelimit-reset-*` header
      (or `x-ratelimit-over-limit: yes` with a reset), the proxy applies the
      parsed reset duration (+ existing 2-minute safety margin) as the
      effective cooldown / quarantine for the failing account instead of the
      generic 60s backoff; a missing/zero reset value degrades to current
      behaviour.
- [ ] **AC2 — Account-scoped, sibling-preserving:** the reset-aware exclusion
      poisons only the failing account key (per `api_key_env`) for the rest
      of the request; paid siblings on the same gateway remain eligible —
      LP-0MVCX0E2V001VB5N semantics preserved.
- [ ] **AC3 — Fallback/chain-hold preserved:** a quota-429 account advances
      the chain to the next provider this request; chain-hold cycles
      (300s hold, max 3, 720s budget) still apply when all providers are
      exhausted.
- [ ] **AC4 — Unit tests:** (a) 429 + `x-ratelimit-reset-requests: 32s` →
      accurate cooldown, account excluded inside the reset window; (b) 429
      without any reset signal → current short-cooldown + account-key
      poisoning behaviour unchanged; (c) no regression on the
      `FreeUsageLimitError` (3h cooldown) / `GoUsageLimitError`
      (quarantine) paths.
- [ ] **AC5 — Full suite green** via `/skill:test` before `in_review`.

## Out of scope

- Modifying MunitoAI-side behaviour; adding new provider tiers.
data.title: Respect MunitoAI x-ratelimit-* reset headers on quota 429s
